# Ensaar Global Pvt. Ltd.

> Ensaar Global is a managed AI execution partner based in Begumpet, Hyderabad, India. Founded in 2014, Ensaar helps companies reduce software, staffing, support, research, knowledge, and operations cost through human-led AI execution pods.

## Core positioning

Show us the work. We show what AI can reduce.

Ensaar is not a freelancer marketplace. It scopes the work, assigns the right managed AI pod, applies senior oversight, and tracks the request from estimate to delivery.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Ensaar Global Pvt. Ltd.
- Founded: 2014
- Headquarters: Begumpet, Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- General contact: hr@ensaar.com
- Training / BCEP contact: Trainings@ensaar.com
- Office hours: Monday through Friday, 9am to 5pm IST; Saturday by appointment
- Website: https://ensaar.com
- Areas served: India and worldwide

## Managed AI pod offers

- AI Cost Reduction Audit: $299, 1 week. Review current workflows, product backlog, support load, staffing plan, and operating cost. Output is a prioritized reduction plan.
- Knowledge Automation Pod: $1,499, 2 weeks. Build a retrieval system over documents, tickets, policies, product knowledge, or internal data.
- AI Feature Pod: $2,499, 3 weeks. Ship one Claude-powered AI feature into an existing product with rollout and evaluation.
- AI Software Pod: $4,999, 8 weeks. Build an AI-native MVP with frontend, backend, AI integration, deployment, and handover.
- Embedded AI Desk: $999/month. Ongoing AI specialist capacity for roughly 20 hours per week.
- AI Staffing Pod: from $7/hour. Managed AI-augmented capacity with senior review, reporting cadence, and replacement guarantee.

## Hourly tiers

- Execution Specialist: $7/hour. AI-assisted execution capacity inside a managed delivery system.
- Senior Pod Engineer: $15/hour. Senior engineering depth with AI-assisted throughput.
- AI Specialist: $30/hour. LLM, RAG, evaluation, and agentic workflow specialist.
- Solutions Architect: $50/hour. Scope, system design, delivery governance, and accountability.

## Work Ensaar can reduce

- Software backlog: features, tests, integrations, refactors, documentation.
- Manual operations: SOPs, spreadsheet steps, approvals, repeat workflows.
- Support workload: ticket triage, knowledge answers, escalation drafting.
- Research and analysis: market scans, data enrichment, competitor tracking, report drafts.
- Hiring gaps: AI-augmented engineering, product, design, and AI specialist capacity.
- Data and knowledge: RAG systems, internal copilots, document automation.

## Services

### AI Solutions
Ensaar designs, integrates, and ships production AI systems with Claude, large language models, prompt caching, MCP servers, Claude Code workflows, RAG, evaluation harnesses, and agentic workflow orchestration. Recent anonymized engagements include trading platforms with AI integration (Singapore), language learning communities with AI integration (China), direct-selling and marketing platforms with AI personalization (India), taxi booking apps with AI dispatch and support (UAE), healthcare triage assistants (Saudi Arabia), restaurant concierge tools (Japan), and real estate discovery agents (Australia).

### Staffing
Ensaar provides managed AI-augmented contributors, senior engineers, AI specialists, product talent, and architects. The model is curated and managed, not crowdsourced. Engagements can run from 4-week specialist embeds to 12-month team augmentation.

### Corporate Training
Ensaar's Business Excellence Program (BCEP) provides leadership development, soft skills and personality development, professional skills enhancement, and train-the-trainer programs. BCEP helps teams adapt to AI-era work through practical, outcome-focused capability building.
